Sectioned instructional airframe (Schnittmodell), Werknummer 1402. Served with JG-1 at Cottbus from April 1965, then JG-2 at Trollenhagen, and from July 1972 as a ground instructional airframe at the officer school in Kamenz. Its right wing comes from MiG-21M 515. On loan from the Militärhistorisches Museum Flugplatz Berlin-Gatow.
